renderings.value: I like the one-sided view foreigners have of Japan. It makes me happy when ninjas, hentai anime, samurai and stuff like that come up.
Isn't that more like something a pervert would say? Not someone expressing their love.
"Despite appearances, you're a pervert." "I'm not a pervert. I'm a pure and innocent young girl." "Yeah, yeah, give me a break."
"What happened, Tom?" "When I asked Mary what cup size she is, she called me a pervert." "What did you expect?"
